connector.name: SERPdive Web Search
connector.registryDescription: AI-agent web search, answer-ready content. Beats Tavily: 60.7% of quality duels, 20.2% fewer tokens.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.serpdive.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package serpdive-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.serpdive. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
